# TPC-Havoc Q15_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_address, s_phone, (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) FROM lineitem AS l2 WHERE l2.l_suppkey = s_suppkey AND l2.l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) AND l2.l_shipdate < CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH') AS total_revenue FROM supplier WHERE (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) FROM lineitem AS l3 WHERE l3.l_suppkey = s_suppkey AND l3.l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) AND l3.l_shipdate < CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH') = (SELECT MAX(supplier_revenue.total_revenue) FROM (SELECT l_suppkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) AND l_shipdate < CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH' GROUP BY l_suppkey) AS supplier_revenue) ORDER BY s_suppkey
```
